source.quote: E3 = Es (rho*/rho_s) ... G13 = Gs (t/l) cos(theta)/(h/l + sin(theta)) = (1/sqrt(3)) Gs (t/l) for regular hexagons (= G23)

limits.note: Derived: rho*/rho_s = (2/sqrt 3)(t/l) so (1/sqrt 3)(t/l) = 0.5 rho*/rho_s. Lecture calls it an estimate ('exact solution requires numerical methods'), not a bound. CR III 5056 3/8-1.0 measured: W 2.93 (63 percent of the estimate), L 6.46 (139 percent); the mean of L and W 4.69 is 101 percent. The honeycomb sits AT the regular-hexagon estimate on average; L exceeds it because expanded honeycomb has double-thickness walls along the ribbon, W falls below it. Parent values are from a web property page (5056-H392, rounded density 2.7); the NASA foil test (5052-H39 foil 8.2-8.3 Msi vs 10 Msi cited) suggests thin foil is about 17 percent softer, which would lower the estimate to about 3.95.

gaps: No aluminium honeycomb values at 1.0 pcf (or any pcf) before 1986. The 1986 NASA table quotes the 1/4-1.6 row, equal to today's. TSB 120 1981/1984/1987/1992 editions and MIL-HDBK-23A (1968) were not found, so the 30-year (about 1996) point is 1998-99 (Data Sheet 2100 12/98, TSB 120 11/99) and the 20-year point 2004; nothing earlier than 1986.

No evidence that Hexcel re-tested: identical printed values over 28 to 40 years may reflect unchanged tables, not unchanged material. No minimum values for stabilized modulus are printed. Crush values are +/-20 percent preliminary values.

Stabilized compressive modulus and plate shear modulus per density were not found for Plascore, Euro-Composites, Alcore or Hexcel Flex-Core at 16-50 kg/m3 beyond what catalog.json holds (Plascore PAMG-XR1 gives shear only).

Carbon honeycomb: only one secondary source (Kondratiev et al. 2023, quoting a 2012 conference paper) for UCF-145-3/8-0.8 (12.8 kg/m3) and UCF-121-1/4-3.0; no primary datasheet for any Ultracor UCF grade, no through-thickness modulus, no crush value, no history. Current availability of the 0.8 pcf grade not confirmed.
Micro/nano-lattices: no shear modulus anywhere; Zheng 2014 and Schaedler 2011 numbers not read (full texts blocked); compressive moduli are figure readings from earlier sourcing files.

Hashin-Shtrikman bound formula not read from any page; not evaluated numerically. Only the Voigt rule-of-mixtures limit and the Gibson-Ashby estimate are given (the Gibson-Ashby G13 formula is an estimate, not a bound). Carbon-wall G/rho not sourced. Parent 5056 properties are from a web property page, not a handbook; foil modulus measured for 5052 only.

Film adhesive: date of first offering of AF 163-2U 0.015 lb/ft2 not found (oldest 3M source read is November 2009); FM 73 lightest weight and Cytec FM 300/73 history before 2011 not found; EA 9696 TDS not obtained; no film lighter than 0.015 psf found; no reticulated-fillet mass measurement for aluminium honeycomb found (Boeing 1975 patent claims 0.02-0.03 lb/ft2 without a table); Okada and Kortschot (2002) not opened; no minimum-fillet theory giving least adhesive for a stated flatwise strength found (Rion gives only fillet-mass geometry).
1954 Hexcel report: 'O.lU lbs per square foot' is OCR text and read as 0.14; the basis of the 0.05 lb/ft2 tape weight (per bond or per panel) is not stated in the text read.
Shear-modulus-vs-density figures in the 2016 guide were not read off; only table rows are recorded.
